ticker: Kolkata Durga Puja stampede claims at least 19 lives
Gwalior temple accident kills 12 devotees after truck crash
US President waives key Russian oil punitive tariffs for India
France faces massive violent protests with over 1,200 arrests
Major fire breaks out at Canadian military base in Alberta

articles.headline: Kolkata Durga Puja Stampede Kills 19
articles.brief: A tragic stampede at Kolkata's Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal during Saptami evening has left at least 19 people dead and 25 others injured. Police have detained 12 organizers, and a sitting high court judge will lead an independent probe into the overcrowding and mismanagement.

articles.headline: Truck Runs Over Devotees in Gwalior
articles.brief: At least 12 people died and several others were injured after a speeding, overloaded truck broke through police barricades and crashed into a temple gate near Gwalior's Sheetla Mata Temple. Authorities have launched an immediate investigation into the security breach.

articles.headline: US Waives Russian Oil Tariffs for India
articles.brief: U.S. President Donald Trump has waived key provisions of the Graham Act that previously authorized punitive tariffs on countries purchasing Russian oil, granting crucial relief to India as announced by Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

articles.headline: France Hit by Violent Protests and Arrests
articles.brief: Nationwide demonstrations in France have escalated into severe violence, featuring widespread fires, looting, and over 1,200 arrests. President Emmanuel Macron has vowed immediate and strict action to restore public order.

articles.headline: Major Fire Breaks Out at Canadian Military Base
articles.brief: A major fire erupted at the Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, prompting deep concern among top officials. Prime Minister Mark Carney categorized the event as serious, while local and federal agencies coordinate emergency responses.

articles.headline: ICICI Bank Q2 Profit Rises 20%
articles.brief: India's ICICI Bank reported a robust 20.1% increase in its second-quarter profit, comfortably beating market expectations driven by strong core operating performance and steady credit demand across retail and corporate sectors.

articles.headline: HDFC Bank Reports Q2 Profit Growth
articles.brief: HDFC Bank posted a 4.7% rise in its second-quarter net profit, alongside an announcement that Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha will step down from his position on December 31.

articles.headline: Prices of Cancer Drugs to Fall Sharply
articles.brief: Under a new pharmaceutical directive effective November 9, prices for 137 critical cancer drugs in India are set to drop by up to 70%. Companies must transparently publish revised lists for hospitals and retailers.

articles.headline: Reliance and Blinkit Executives Face FIR
articles.brief: An Indian state food safety authority has registered an FIR against top executives from Reliance and Blinkit as part of an expanding state-wide probe into the distribution of expired consumer food products.

articles.headline: IPL 2027 Auction Locked for Goa
articles.brief: The Board of Control for Cricket in India has officially confirmed that the IPL 2027 player auction will take place on December 16 in Goa, with franchise team briefings scheduled for the preceding day.

articles.headline: Tesla Vehicle Crashes into Police Cruiser
articles.brief: A Tesla vehicle operating on Full Self-Driving mode allegedly crashed into a California Highway Patrol vehicle while officers were investigating a separate fatal collision on Interstate 80.
